children: Cardinal Infrastructure Group's revenue rose 65.1% year over year, driven by acquisition-related growth and higher residential project volumes. Earnings attributable to the company declined to a loss, as a $13.2 million project cost estimate adjustment, residential pricing pressure, lower initial bid margins on some commercial and industrial projects, and higher fuel and transportation costs weighed on gross margin.
Revenue was $201.93M, compared with $122.32M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 65.1%.
Net income was ($4.4M), compared with $7.09M in the prior-year quarter; turned to loss.
: Acquisition-related growth contributed approximately $55.7 million, while organic growth contributed $23.9 million.
: Gross margin fell to 5.4% from 15.9%; project cost estimate revisions reduced gross profit by $13.2 million.
: Backlog was $815.5 million at September 30, 2026, up from $646.0 million at September 30, 2025.
: The company expects to recognize $721.0 million to $797.0 million of backlog in the 12 months following September 30, 2026.
